name: RasterRaid
tagline: Search Civitai and see how results connect.
description: Search Civitai models, media, guides, and other public listings. Build reports with exact source links, save your picks, and see live Deep Search prices.

scopeJustifications.collections:read:private: Search your own private and unlisted collections and preview eligible collection media after you choose to share them. RasterRaid keeps these results in the current tab.
scopeJustifications.ai:write:budgeted: Price Deep Search with its app author fee, run it with Buzz after you confirm an estimate, and reopen your RasterRaid results. Quotes and history use 0 Buzz.
